02 / THE HUMAN BEHIND THE TABS

Hi, I’m Raphael.
I like connecting
unlikely dots.

☺Curiosity is
the common thread.

A bassline. A better school day.
A spreadsheet that finally behaves.

They might look like different worlds. To me, they start with the same question: could this feel better?

I’m there in person, too. I advise social initiatives and work alongside their teams to introduce AI safely and sensibly. We find useful applications, set clear boundaries, and turn first experiments into something that works in everyday practice.

I build at the intersection of code, sound, and education. Sometimes that means going deep into a synthesizer’s signal path. Sometimes it means making a complicated workflow feel simple. And sometimes, it means hiding a game where you least expect it.

That can mean a conversation, a hands-on workshop, support with implementation, or a custom software solution built around your organisation. I stay close to the people using it, from the first question to everyday use.

01 / ADVICE & WORKSHOPS

Find where AI makes sense.

Personal advice and practical workshops. We look at your work together, identify useful applications, and build confidence in the team.

02 / RESPONSIBLE IMPLEMENTATION

Make it useful. Keep people in control.

Introduce AI with care: sensible data use, clear responsibilities, human oversight, and routines that fit your organisation.

03 / CUSTOM SOFTWARE

Build what your team actually needs.

From a small automation to your own software product. I design and build solutions around your processes—and help you put them to work.

question.

01

Get close to the real thing.

Sit down together. Understand the people, the work, and the real need before choosing a tool or writing code.

02

Make something you can try.

Try a useful first version together. Combine practical guidance, AI implementation, and custom development where they make a difference.

03

Check the results with the team. Refine the software, establish sensible boundaries, and make sure people can use it confidently.

A little rigour. A little intuition. Room for a happy accident.
